frontmatter.title: The Money-Time Exchange
frontmatter.statement: When is an hour of volunteering worth more than giving an hour’s wages?
frontmatter.progress: A framework that estimates the value of volunteer time by role and skill, checked against organizations’ own assessments.
frontmatter.bounty: Unfunded. The Question Bounties program will attach prizes once it is funded.

subject.body:
## Why it matters

Volunteer time can help in different ways and also takes coordination. The proposed study would compare the value of roles with the cost of supporting them; it does not assume those answers are already known.

## Where to start

Ask organizations what an hour of each kind of volunteer help is worth to them, and compare that with the volunteer’s wage. See [Time Charitology](/programs/time-charitology/).
